title: manage_event
description: Calendar events — standalone dated commitments (a conference, an appointment). op: put/get/query/delete; query lists a subject's events with starts_at in a [start,end] window.

op.description: put | get | query | delete. query returns one subject's events whose starts_at falls in [start,end].

event_id.description: Key of an event. Created on put if omitted; required for get/delete.

subject.description: Whose calendar this event is on — the person's contact_id (from modules/contacts), the same id labor and inventory use for a person. Required on put and query.

expr.description: When: an ISO date/datetime for a one-off, or an RFC 5545 RRULE for recurring (pass starts_at explicitly for recurring).

description.description: Human description of the event (e.g. 'AcmeConf, Vegas').

starts_at.description: Concrete first/next occurrence (ISO) — the date index. Defaults to expr for a one-off; required for a recurring expr.

contact_id.description: Optional FK — a contact this event is about.

invoice_id.description: Optional FK — an invoice this event is about.
